Additionally, Justin's room rates are fantastic. I don't go to Vegas often so I figured the other guys in my party would have their own tricks to get the best rate. But a friend connected me with Justin and I figured I'd get a quote just to see. To my surprise, it was better than what my other buddies could get. I will definitely be booking with Justin again in the future.
